parts.title: Task 1
parts.passage_text:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The pie charts below show reasons why people left the UK for other countries and why people stayed in the UK.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.passage_text: Some people think that good health is important to everyone, so medical services should not be run by profit-making companies. Do the disadvantages of private health care outweigh the advantages?
